Class ControllerDiscussionBoard

java.lang.Object
guiDiscussionBoard.ControllerDiscussionBoard
public class ControllerDiscussionBoard extends Object

Title: ControllerDiscussionBoard

Description: This class is the controller for the discussion board, and is instantiated by the view in order to carry out operations conducted by the UI buttons created in the view. It's methods are non static and are heavily utilized by the view class

Version:
1.03
Author:
Sutton Harr

    • canEdit

      public boolean canEdit(Post post, boolean delete, boolean silenceNotification)
      Determines if a user has permissions to edit a post Provides an error message if not silenced, the content of the message is based on the delete boolean
      Parameters:
      post - the post object in which the current users credentials must be validated for
      delete - boolean to determine the content of the error message (True "delete" : False "edit")
      silenceNotification - boolean to determine if an error message should be displayed upon invalid credentials
      Returns:
      a boolean indicating if the current user has the authority to edit the post parameter

    • canEdit

      public boolean canEdit(Reply reply, boolean delete, boolean silenceNotification)
      Determines if a user has permissions to edit a reply Provides an error message if not silenced, the content of the message is based on the delete boolean
      Parameters:
      reply - the object reply in which the current users credentials must be validated for
      delete - boolean to determine the content of the error message (True "delete" : False "edit")
      silenceNotification - boolean to determine if an error message should be displayed upon invalid credentials
      Returns:
      a boolean indicating if the current user has the authority to edit the reply parameter
